svg.aria-label: Slot display matrix: period rows vs time blocks, label variants
svg.title: Slot display matrix: period rows vs time blocks, label variants
svg.text: Düzen × etiket: how the /bookings day grid renders each choice (desktop, standard density)
Timeline: height = minutes × 1.1 px (standard), 10-min breaks become gaps, the 30-min 17:30 slot is visibly shorter. Lists and chips ignore Düzen; phones keep ≥ 44 px rows.
Every cell and row keeps a full accessible name (‘3. ders, 10:10–10:50’) whatever the visible label.
